name: digitalnz
description: DigitalNZ (digitalnz.org) is a search portal for New Zealand cultural heritage collections. No commands are available because every recorded page was blocked by an AWS WAF bot challenge.
notes: Every digitalnz.org document request (/, /records?text=kauri, /developers) returned HTTP 202. Each response contained only an empty body > div#challenge-container plus the AWS WAF challenge script. No real page content or site data was ever served.

The only other traffic was the AWS WAF token flow: GET .../inputs?client=browser and POST .../mp_verify. These requests are anti-bot infrastructure, not site features. They require a browser-computed solution and fingerprint signals, so they were skipped.
No command was written for the HTML pages. Replaying them without a valid aws-waf-token cookie returns the same empty challenge page, so any extract would yield nothing and fail verification.

DigitalNZ is publicly known to offer a documented JSON API (api.digitalnz.org, e.g. /records.json?text=...&api_key=...). However, none of its requests appeared in this recording, so no command was invented for it.

To build a working CLI, re-run exploration so the WAF challenge completes, for example in a non-headless or stealth browser, or after waiting for the challenge to solve and the page to reload. A better option is to explore the developer API host directly, so that real search, record-detail and facet requests get recorded.
